body.statement:
Conditional on effective compatibility density, the effective moving-remainder assumption, and effective moving-offset encoding, suppose \(p_n(0)\to p_0\), \(p_n(u)-p_0\in\operatorname{lin}(\mathcal P_{\mathrm{ASC}}-p_0)\), \(c_n\to c\in\mathcal K_0\), and \(\delta_n(C)=\max_j\sup_{u\in C}|e_{n,j}(u)|\to0\) on every rational compact polytope \(C\). Compute \(\widehat c_n\in\mathcal K_0\cap\mathbb Q^{|\mathcal J_0^{\mathrm{act}}|}\) with \(\|\widehat c_n-c_n\|_\infty\le\xi_n\), certify a Gaussian rule for \(\mathfrak G_0(\widehat c_n)\), and transfer it by Carter's positive-cell kernel. On each fixed compact \(C\), put \(\chi_n(C)=d_n(C)+\delta_n(C)+\xi_n\). Its semantic coverage deficit and normalized separated-risk excess are bounded by
\[
 \varepsilon_{\mathrm{Car},n}+\operatorname{Err}_{\Sigma,n}(C)
 +\mathfrak b_0\{\tau_n+\chi_n(C)\}
 +H_C\chi_n(C)+\mathbf1\{\chi_n(C)>\tau_n\}
 +\rho_{\mathrm{led},n}+\operatorname{Tail}_n(C)+\operatorname{Round}_n.
\]
The effective remainder, offset, Gaussian-integration, and certificate ledgers choose \(\tau_n,\xi_n\downarrow0\) and vanishing certificate accuracy so that this bound tends to zero. The construction uses \(\widehat c_n\), not the unknown limit \(c\), and makes no global-honesty claim on the unbounded regions \(D_{n,v}\).
body.justification: The theorem now gives a determinate compact moving-offset rule using computable rational approximations to the observed offset.
body.gap: It does not extend compact control to all unbounded finite-sample truth regions.
body.consumer: Drifting capacity and endpoint-program faces receive an explicit boundary and offset charge.
body.proof_tex:
Membership of \(c_n\) in \(\mathcal K_0\) follows from \(\text{ass:local-family-affine-hull}\) by applying the active-row map \(A_\Psi\) to \(\sqrt n\{p_n(0)-p_0\}\). The effective encoding assumption supplies \(\widehat c_n\) at tolerance \(\xi_n\). For every active facet,
\[
 \zeta_{n,j}(u)-(\widehat c_{n,j}+a_j'u)
 =(c_{n,j}-\widehat c_{n,j})+e_{n,j}(u),
\]
so the absolute error is at most \(\xi_n+\delta_n(C)\). Applying \(\text{lem:finite-completed-arrangement-stability}\) to all completed systems simultaneously shows that every actual semantic membership on \(C\) is represented in the \(\widehat c_n\)-experiment at a mean displaced by at most \(H_C\{\xi_n+\delta_n(C)\}\); its directed Hausdorff conclusion treats the separated-risk sets. Score centering adds the mean error bounded by \(d_n(C)\), producing \(H_C\chi_n(C)\).

By \(\text{thm:certglue-termination}\), conditional on effective compatibility density, the experiment \(\mathfrak G_0(\widehat c_n)\) has a replayable certified Gaussian rule at any prescribed rational accuracy. Apply the forward Carter kernel from \(\text{cor:carter-fixed-m-positive-cell}\) and the score map from the proof of \(\text{thm:fixed-stratum-transfer}\). The total-variation loss is
\(\varepsilon_{\mathrm{Car},n}+\operatorname{Err}_{\Sigma,n}(C)\), and \(\text{lem:bounded-semantic-transfer-by-tv}\) converts it separately into coverage and diameter-risk errors. If a sign can change, then either \(\chi_n(C)>\tau_n\) or the corresponding affine slack lies in a band of width \(\tau_n+\chi_n(C)\). The union bound and the displayed one-dimensional Gaussian density bound in \(\mathfrak b_0\) give exactly \(\mathfrak b_0\{\tau_n+\chi_n(C)\}\). The finite-arrangement displacement gives the \(H_C\chi_n(C)\) term. Gaussian truncation, outward integration, and rationalization contribute the three displayed ledger terms, each with its declared sign because all enclosures are outward.

Choose the certificate accuracy, tail radius, and rounding precision at most \(1/n\). The effective assumptions permit a diagonal choice of \(\xi_n,\tau_n\downarrow0\) with \(\chi_n(C)/\tau_n\to0\) on any prescribed compact-exhaustion schedule. Then the indicator is eventually zero, \(\mathfrak b_0\{\tau_n+\chi_n(C)\}\to0\), Carter's error is \(O(n^{-1/2})\), and the Gaussian covariance error tends to zero by \(\text{lem:compact-moving-remainder-covariance}\). This proves the compact bound and its limit. No step controls \(u\) outside the chosen compact, which proves the stated scope rather than global honesty.
